motion.name: login-settle
motion.purpose: The single authored entrance moment for the login panel; no other animation exists on this surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width submit control; the only bordered/boxed element on the login surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-strawberry, oklch(0.52 0.19 25)); color: var(--color-strawberry-foreground, oklch(0.99 0 0)); border: none; border-radius: 0; width: 100%; height: 3rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-strawberry-hover, oklch(0.57 0.19 25)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-strawberry-focus, oklch(0.62 0.19 20)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: Text/email/password input with no box, just a chalk-rule underline; the field's label sits above in tracked caps.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-chalk-label, oklch(0.82 0.02 120)); margin-bottom: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-board-rule, oklch(0.42 0.02 165)); color: var(--color-chalk-white, oklch(0.97 0.01 90)); font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-chalk-placeholder, oklch(0.55 0.02 165)); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--color-strawberry-focus, oklch(0.62 0.19 20)); }

narrative.overview: CPAM Conecta is an internal record system for a small strawberry market in Bom Repouso/MG, used by one or two people on a phone, often on a weak connection. Its first surface reads as the first chalked row on the wholesale market's own price board: a matte, near-black slate-green ground; warm chalk-white type; one strawberry-red accent spent only on the primary action and the focus state. Fields are ruled rows, not boxes. The board's material is authored, not implied: a low-opacity fractal-noise grain sits under the content so the ground reads as a painted, textured surface rather than a flat color standing in for one.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: one dark neutral ground, one warm accent, spent narrowly.
No boxed containers, no cards, no rounded corners anywhere.
Fields are underlined rows (a chalk rule), not bordered boxes.
Bold, tracked, uppercase labels; all other text sentence case.
Confirmed visual rejection: no white/light auth-card template, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no glyph/emoji icons standing in for drawn ones.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Strawberry red appears in exactly two places: the primary button and a focused field's rule. It never decorates a label, a link, or a passive element.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every weight and case on this surface comes from Geist. A second, more decorative face was deliberately not introduced.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this surface casts a shadow. Depth comes from the authored grain texture, not elevation.

dos: Do spend the strawberry accent only on the primary action and on focus.
Do underline fields with a single rule instead of boxing them.
Do show errors inline, in place, in sentence case with the recovery implied.
donts: Don't introduce a second display font.
Don't use a kicker/eyebrow label, a gradient, glassmorphism, or a hard offset neobrutalist shadow.
Don't stand in an emoji or Unicode glyph for an icon.
